entities.summary: Malcolm Gilbert Sayer was a British aircraft engineer during wartime and later automotive aerodynamist and designer. His most notable aerodynamic work was the engineering body development and design of the E-Type Jaguar and early style guidelines for Jaguar XJS. He spent the last twenty years of his life working at Jaguar Cars and was one of the first engineers to apply principles of aircraft streamlining and aerodynamic function to cars.
